summary: A Dyer County Aermotor-style lookout administered by the Division of Forestry; registered 2023, but the TNLandForms.us list marks it removed and no build date is known.

facts.status_note: TNLandForms.us list (independent site, revised January 8, 2026) marks it removed; the 2023 NHLR entry gives no status

access.note: NHLR describes no obvious access points

events.note: Registered January 1, 2023; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: Aermotor-style tower with no obvious access points
evidence.quote: This is an Aermotor style tower with no obvious access points.

evidence.supports: administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry
TNLandForms.us list marks the Dyersburg tower as removed

corrections.why: No source read says the tower is standing; the TNLandForms.us list marks it removed, and the 2023 NHLR entry gives no status

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2023 NHLR entry gives no status; the TNLandForms.us list, revised January 8, 2026, marks it removed. Recorded as unknown until a newer source appears.

notes_for_editor: Two WebSearch queries (Division of Forestry removal; Dyer County Aermotor history) found no source on this tower. The TNLandForms.us list gives elevation 483 ft against the register's 497 ft; the register figure is recorded in the story only as context and is not a fact key. The status question needs the Tennessee Division of Forestry or a local record before publication. TNLandForms.us is an independent site, not an official state list; the story no longer calls it one.
